@deskSetFrameAdvanced.description: Settings sidebar entry and page name of the Advanced section. Narrow (about 200 px).

deskSetAdvIntro: Everything here is off to begin with. Each switch adds one more part of the wallet, in the place it belongs.

@deskSetAdvShows.description: Title of the group of visibility switches on Settings › Advanced.

@deskSetAdvOutputs.description: Advanced switch: the Outputs page in the sidebar.

deskSetAdvOutputsHint: Shows the Outputs page in the sidebar. It lists the coins the balance is made of, lets you split or consolidate them, and sets the defaults a send uses. A split or consolidation in progress keeps the page visible.

@deskSetAdvOutputsHint.description: Hover card of the Outputs switch.

@deskSetAdvTechnical.description: Advanced switch: technical rows on transactions.

deskSetAdvTechnicalHint: Shows the Technical details fold on every transaction: slate ID, kernel, block height, the core's status and type, and the payment proof. Without it, a More link on a transaction shows them once. In Invoices, shows the Advanced folds.

@deskSetAdvTechnicalHint.description: Hover card of the Technical details switch on the Advanced page.

@deskSetAdvSendOptions.description: Advanced switch: the Advanced fold on Send.

deskSetAdvSendOptionsHint: Adds a fold to Send where one send can choose which outputs it spends, Smallest or All, and whether to split the change. The defaults stay on Outputs.

@deskSetAdvSendOptionsHint.description: Hover card of the Send options switch.

@deskSetAdvDirect.description: Advanced switch: HTTP and Tor receiving.

deskSetAdvDirectHint: Gives this computer its own address, over HTTP or Tor. Others can pay it directly, without Epicbox. Works only while the wallet is open. Adds the Direct method to Send, the addresses to Receive, and their settings under Receiving. A listener that is on keeps its rows.

@deskSetAdvDirectHint.description: Hover card of the Direct receiving switch.

@deskSetAdvServerDetails.description: Advanced switch: hosts, latency, version, height.

deskSetAdvServerDetailsHint: Shows hosts, latency, version and block height in the node and Epicbox lists, on the sidebar's status rows and in the status card.

@deskSetAdvServerDetailsHint.description: Hover card of the Server details switch.

@deskSetAdvRecheck.description: Advanced switch: recheck balance from a height, delete unconfirmed, restore from a height.

deskSetAdvRecheckHint: Lets Recheck balance also drop unconfirmed transactions. Restore offers a start block to everyone, whatever this says.

@deskSetAdvRecheckHint.description: Hover card of the Recheck from a height switch on the Advanced page.

@deskSetAdvBuiltInNode.description: Advanced switch: the node on this computer.

deskSetAdvBuiltInNodeHint: Lets this computer run its own node: the This computer option under Node, its sync panel, and Start node on Overview. The chain takes hours to sync and several gigabytes of disk. A node that is running keeps its rows.

@deskSetAdvBuiltInNodeHint.description: Hover card of the Built-in node switch.

deskSetAdvLogsHint: Shows the Logs group under Help: open the log folder, clear the logs. Report a problem attaches the log either way.

@deskSetAdvLogsHint.description: Hover card of the Logs switch.

@deskSetAdvNetwork.description: Title of the network mode group on Settings › Advanced.

deskSetAdvNetworkHint: How the wallet reaches the network. Standard connects directly; Tor can be turned on under Privacy. Tor only never connects directly: without Tor the wallet stays offline and says so in the sidebar. Offline stays on this computer and your local network: with a node here or on your network you can still send to local addresses, receive over Direct and use files; the built-in node keeps running, as its own peers are the node's setting.

@deskSetAdvNetworkHint.description: Hover card of the Network group on the Advanced page: what the three network modes do.

deskSetAdvModeStandardText: Connects directly. Tor can be turned on under Privacy.
deskSetAdvModeTorOnlyText: Every connection goes through Tor. Without Tor the wallet stays offline and says so.

@deskSetAdvModeTorOnlyText.description: Text under the Tor only mode.

deskSetAdvModeOfflineText: Only this computer and your local network. Your node keeps running; its own peers are the node's setting.

@deskSetAdvModeOfflineText.description: One-line description of the Offline network mode on the Advanced page.

deskSetAdvTorOnlyNote: Tor only turns HTTP receiving off: a plain address would reveal this computer.

@deskSetAdvTorOnlyNote.description: Note under the network choice while Tor only is selected.

deskSetAdvOfflineNote: Epicbox, Tor and status checks pause. With a node on this computer or your network, Recheck balance, files and Direct to local addresses still work.

@deskSetAdvOfflineNote.description: Note under the chosen Offline mode on the Advanced page.

@deskSetAdvNotInBuild.description: Tag on a Tor mode when the build has no tor.

@deskSetAdvReset.description: Button at the end of Settings › Advanced: turns every visibility switch off. The network mode stays.

deskSetAdvOn: {n, plural, =1{1 switch on} other{{n} switches on}}

@deskSetAdvOn.description: State line of the Advanced page head: how many visibility switches are on.

@deskShellOffline.description: Sidebar status row while the Offline network mode is on.

@deskShellTorOnlyWaiting.description: Sidebar status row while Tor only is on and Tor is not connected yet.

deskNetOfflineReason: Offline mode is on in Advanced.

@deskNetOfflineReason.description: Why a network action is disabled while the Offline network mode is on (Settings › Advanced). One short line, shown beside or under the disabled control.

@deskErrOfflineOnlyLocal.description: Why a Direct send was refused in the Offline network mode: the address is not on this computer or the local network.

deskNetOfflineNoPeers: Your node has no peers: the payment waits in its pool until it reconnects.

@deskNetOfflineNoPeers.description: Notice on Send in the Offline mode when the local node in use has no peers.

deskNetWaitingTorReason: Waiting for Tor. Tor only is on in Advanced.

@deskNetWaitingTorReason.description: Why a network action is disabled in Tor only mode while Tor is not connected yet. One short line.

deskNetTorOnlyLine: Tor only is on in Advanced.

@deskNetTorOnlyLine.description: Line under the Tor switch in Settings › Privacy while the Tor only network mode keeps the switch on and locked.

@deskNetOpenAdvanced.description: Link or small button that opens Settings › Advanced, next to a line that names the network mode.

@deskNetSendFileHint.description: Second line of the notice on Send when the network mode holds Epicbox and Direct sends.

deskNetRecvOfflineText: Your address stays the same. Nothing can arrive until Offline mode is off.

@deskNetRecvOfflineText.description: Text of the notice on Receive while Offline mode is on.

deskNetRecvWaitTorText: Receiving starts when Tor is connected. A transaction file still works.

@deskNetRecvWaitTorText.description: Text of the notice on Receive in Tor only mode while Tor is not connected yet.

@deskNetCantReceive.description: Detail of the Epicbox state line on Receive while Offline mode is on.

@deskRailOffline.description: Word on a sidebar status row (Node, Epicbox, Tor) and the mark on the Overview balance while Offline mode is on.

@deskSetAdvNodeFailover.description: Switch on Settings › Advanced, under the network modes: on by default.

deskSetAdvNodeFailoverHint: When your node stops answering, the wallet uses the next working node in your list for this session.

@deskSetAdvNodeFailoverHint.description: Hover card of the Node failover switch on Settings › Advanced.
